title: Build the Profiled Pipeline
prompt: Implement PriceBook (prebuilt totals, counted lookups), TopSkus (frequency, deterministic ties), and Summary (single materialized pass).

tests.name: book totals without per-call work
tests.hint: Total sums from the prebuilt array; LookupCount stays at zero.

tests.name: top skus with deterministic ties
tests.code:
var top = Solution.TopSkus(new[] { 3, 3, 1, 1, 2, 2, 2, 5 }, 3);
Cj.Eq(string.Join("|", top), "2|1|3", "freq desc, ties by smaller sku");
tests.hint: Count frequencies, order by count desc then sku asc, take 3.

tests.name: summary from one pass
tests.hint: Summary reuses the materialized distinct list, joined with commas.

tests.name: lookups are counted
